Commentary.Commentary: That is all we have for you from this game. The series might be done and dusted but Zimbabwe still have pride to play for as they aim to avoid a whitewash. Join us on Friday, October 26, 2018 at 2.30 pm local (0830 GMT) for all the action from the third ODI. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Zimbabwe's skipper, Hamilton Masakadza admits that they failed to kick on after a good start and credits the Bangladesh openers for the way they batted. Bangladesh's skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza mentions that it was a crucial toss to win with dew expected to set in later in the evening. Lauds his openers and bowlers for a good effort.
MOHAMMAD SAIFUDDIN HAS BEEN NAMED THE MAN OF THE MATCH FOR HIS SPLENDID 3-FER.
Who is your Man Of The Match? Saifuddin for his three-fer? Liton for his quickfire start? Or Kayes for yet another 50-plus score? The answer will get clearer in a while...

Both the openers were unlucky to miss out on their centuries. At one stage, it looked like it will be a 10-wicket win. The pitch had nothing to offer and that was evident from the bowling. Sikandar Raza was the only man who picked up wickets and he ended up taking all three.

Comfortable win for Bangladesh. They might have stretched it a bit, till the 45th over, but they were never in doubt of winning. The openers set it up nicely with a 148-run stand and after that, the visitors barely managed to come back.
SIX! MATCH AND SERIES FOR BANGLADESH. A short ball, around off, Mithun rocks back and pulls it way over square leg!
Cephas Zhuwao to bowl what could be the final over of the match...
Very straight and quick, punched back to the bowler.
Down the leg side, Mushfiqur misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads towards short fine leg but they do not run.
Full and around off, turned towards mid on for a single.
Outside off, pushed straight to cover.
FOUR! Just four more needed now. Dropped short, Mithun goes back and pulls it over mid on for a boundary.
Full and around off, driven straight to short extra cover.
Landed on off, well blocked out.
Around off, watchfully defended.
FOUR! Finally finds the gap. A length ball outside off, Rahim waits till the last minute before deftly guiding it to the third man fence. There is a fielder who slides to his left but in vain.
Landed outside off, Mushfiqur waits for the ball to come to him and guides it behind point for a couple.
The batsman guides it to third man. He is inside the circle, so no run.
Landed outside off, dabbed towards third man for a single.
Full and around middle, MM stays inside the line and drives it towards long off for one more.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
On middle and leg, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Nothing much on the Free Hit. Full and outside off, Mithun looks to slog but gets a leading edge which goes over covers. A run taken.
FREE HIT TIME...
NO BALL. Criminal. A spinner overstepping. Full and around off, Rahim slogs it towards mid on for a single.
Full and around middle, watchfully defended.
Sean Williams time.
NEARLY. Drags it on. On a length outside off, MM looks to defend but the ball stays low, takes the bottom edge and almost rolls back onto the stumps.
On a length outside off, Mithun defends watchfully.
FOUR! Gets it into the gap. A long hop, this gets pulled through mid on and finds the fence.
A short ball outside off, pulled through mid-wicket for a couple.
Around off, watchfully defended
Landed outside off, Rahim opens the face of his bat and steers it towards third man for a single.
POWERPLAY 3 TIME. 5 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle now. A bowling change as well, with Tendai Chatara coming on.
Full and outside off, Rahim looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge which runs down to short third man. A run taken.
A touch short outside off, Rahim looks to flick but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for a couple.
Full and outside off, well blocked out.
Outside off, spinning in, played straight to point.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Around off, solidly defended.
WIDE. Down the leg side, left alone.
Outside off, a touch short, Mithun slashes hard but misses.
The ball has struck the batsman hard on his hand.
Full and outside off, eased straight to cover.
The batsman picked that bouncer early and let it through to the keeper.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Full and outside off, Mithun looks to slog but gets a top edge. Luckily for him, the ball lands just short of the man at deep mid-wicket! Two runs taken.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a couple.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Mohammad Mithun walks in at number 5, replacing Kayes.

OUT! Throws it away! No century for Kayes. Full and outside off, Imrul dances down the track, looking to go over the top but cannot quite get the distance. He finds Chigumbura at long off who cups it with ease.
WIDE. Down the leg side, flick shot missed.
Outside off, punched off the back foot.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Kayes easily pulls it towards fine leg for a run. He is into the 90s now.
Worked towards mid-wicket.
Uses his feet and then at the very end guides it down to third man for a run.
Good length on off, Rahim defends it out.
Another shortish delivery, is is pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length ball on off, kept out.
Fires it on middle, Rahim works it to mid-wicket.
Pulls it but to the fielder in the deep at the mid-wicket region. A single.
Another ball down the leg side, this time it flicks the pad of the batsman and no wide given.
Down the leg side and it has been signaled as a wide.
Bowls it flatter on off, Rahim pushes it through covers for another single.
Gives it air on middle, the batter flicks it through mid-wicket and they cross.
A half tracker. Rahim fails to pick the gap and finds short fine leg. The fielder there misfields and a run is taken.
Punches it through covers and gets to the other end. Also the 50-run stand is up between the two. They have taken their team to the brink of victory.
Nudged around the corner for a run.
FOUR! Right in the gap! 200 up and runs needed is below fifty! Short and on middle, Kayes pulls it in the gap between the mid-wicket region and a boundary results.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.
Tosses it up on middle, Kayes flicks it through mid-wicket.
On the shorter side outside off, Rahim punches it through covers and takes a run.
Shorter and outside off, the batter pushes it through covers for a run.
Down the leg sode, Rahim tries to flick but misses and it has been wided.
FOUR! A friendly full toss and Rahim takes full toll of it. He sweeps it over backward square leg and into the fence.
The googly on middle, Rahim defends it onto the ground.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FLatter on the stumps this time, Kayes gets behind the line and defends.
FLatter on off, Kayes guides it to point.
Works it away on the leg side for another run.
Brandon Mavuta is back on.
Brandon Mavuta is back on.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Flicks it with the turn through square leg for a run.
Eases this down to long off for a single.
Fires it on the pads, Rahim tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Flatter and outside off, Kayes tries to cut but the ball takes the outside edge and goes towards the third man fence. The fielder from short third man hares after it and keeps it down to three.
Sean Williams is back into the attack.
Sean Williams is back into the attack.
Flatter and outside off, Rahim tries to guide it very late but gets beaten.
The batsman has driven it through mid-off. The batsmen have run through for a single.
This is a little too full outside off, Rahim drives it through covers and the batsmen take a run.
Wide outside off, Kayes slaps it through covers for another run.
Outside off, Rahim guides it towards short third man for a single.
SIX! BOOM! THat should break the shackles! Rahim uses his feet and with the turn tonks it over the long on fence. The little man hit that a long way.
On the pads, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Now Rahim works it with the angle through square leg for a run.
Back of a length again on off, Kayes stands tall and punches it through covers for a run.
Back of a length on off, Kayes pushes it to covers.

DROPPED! Has Mavuta just dropped the game? You would surely feel so. Another life for Kayes. This is slightly short and around off, Kayes tries to drag his pull towards the leg side. He does so uppishly towards mid-wicket. Mavuta there jumps and gets two hands to it but the ball bursts through and the batsmen take two. Can't drop these, you need these to be taken, especially at this situation of the game.
A good bouncer, Kayes goes for the pull without watching the ball but misses.
Drinks!
Drinks!
Drinks!
Drinks!
A low full toss on the pads, the batsman works it fine down the leg side for a run.
Just a run as Rahim sweeps it to deep mid-wicket.
On the off pole, the batsman defends it. So runs have dried up here.
Short and wide outside off, Rahim tries to cut but misses.
Full on off, pushed to long off for an easy run.
Darts this full outside off, Rahim guides it towards backward point for one.
Length ball on off, the batsman prods forward and defends it towards covers. They set off for a run and complete it.
Good length again on off, the batsman defends it out.
Fuller in length on middle, the batter drives it to mid on.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Back of a length on off, Rahim guides it through point for a run.
On the pads, the batsman tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards fine leg and the batsmen take a leg bye.
Eased down to long off for a run.
Short and outside off, Kayes slaps it past the diving cover fielder for a brace.

Turn there! It pitches on middle, Kayes looks to work it on the leg side but the ball spins away sharply. Takes the leading edge but lands safe in the cover region. The key there was Kayes played that with soft hands.
On the off pole, the batsman blocks it out.
Works it to the man at short fine leg.
Works it to the man at short fine leg.
Another good nut! On off and on a length, kept out.
Good delivery! On a length around off, left alone.
Down the leg side and it has been wided.
Fuller in length on off, the batsman times it through covers for a couple. 92 more needed.
Back of a length on off, guided to point.
Good length on off, kept out.
The batsman plays the pull-shot. They pick up a single.
Loopy ball outside off, Rahim tries to guide it but the ball turns back in and takes the bottom edge.
Mushfiqur Rahim is the new man in.

OUT! Mahmud is short! One gets two and Zimbabwe are fighting back. Mahmud bags a duck. Raza is once again the man to get another. The batsman dances down the track but is beaten by the flight and the turn away. He tries to push it away but the ball whizzes past the outside edge. Taylor behind the stumps, tries to collect but fumbles at first. He whips the bails off in the second attempt as the batsman tries to get back in. The players appeal and the umpire takes it upstairs. Replays show Mahmud is short.
Have Zimbabwe got another? Well they are pretty confident as an appeal for a stumping has been taken upstairs. Mahmud is the man in question.
Flatter again on off, Mahmud guides it to point.
On the stumps, kept out.
Flatter and on off, the batsman guides it through point for a run.
Flatter on middle, the batsman keeps it out.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Once again walks down the track but gets a short one. He stands tall and pulls it. Again the timing is not there but the batsman get two.
Miscue but safe! 150 up with that brace! Full and on off, Kayes tries to go over mid off. It is off the toe end and lands safe in that region. The fielder there misfields and concedes an extra run.
Back of a length again on off, IK tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Shortish and outside off, the ball stays a touch low. Kayes tries to pull but gets a bottom edge to the keeper.
Fuller in length on off, it is stroked towards mid off.
Fazle Mahmud is the new man in. Also, Kyle Jarvis is back on.
Fazle Mahmud is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Zimbabwe have finally broken through. A little late one would say. Nevertheless, they have ended the massive stand. Raza is the man to do so. He tosses it up once again. Das dances down the track and tries to go over the cover-point fielder. He does not get the timing though and it lobs towards that fielder. Tiripano there takes an easy catch. Das walks back dejected as he misses out on a ton. However, he has done a really good job for his team.
FOUR! A hit me ball that! Short and wide outside off, Das goes back and cuts it through point. The ball races away.
Plays it very late but finds the backward point fielder.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! UP AND OVER! Das makes room and gets a full ball outside off, it is lofted over covers, no man in the deep so a boundary results.

CHANCE! A tough one, a very tough one. It is short and outside off, Kayes tries to cut but the ball takes the outside edge and hits Taylor's outside part of the gloves. Goes towards short third man for a run.
Flatter and outside off, Das guides it to point.
Eased down to long on for a run.
Plays the reverse sweep but finds the man at point.
EDGY FOUR! Kayes there lost his shape as he went for the heave. The ball takes the outside edge and beats the short third man fielder and into the fence.
The batsman drives this through the covers.
Down the leg side, Kayes tries to flick but he misses. There is an appeal from the bowler and keeper, maybe to put the umpire off. However, he is not distracted and signals it as a wide.
A little too wide outside off, left alone. It has been wided.
Floats it up outside off, the batter guides it to point.
Ends it with a dot as Das works it with the turn to mid-wicket. A single from the over, Zimbabwe need a lot more of such tight overs and build pressure.
Tosses it up on off, it is hit back to the bowler. A good over till now.
Flatter on middle, Das pushes it to covers.
It was the faster one but it was short and on the pads, Das tries to pull but finds short fine leg. He will be disappointed there as there was a boundary for the taking.
Loopy ball on middle, Kayes strokes it past the bowler and down to long off for a run.
Flatter and outside off, Kayes guides it to backward point.
Brings the reverse sweep out, Chatara at short third man does really well to dive to his right and make a good stop. Can't stop the single though.
On the stumps, Das plants his front foot across and then works it around the corner for a run.
Tosses it up outside off, Das tries to hit it through the off side. Maybe he went a little too hard there as he gets a bottom edge on it.
Kayes now eases it down to long on for another run.
Flatter on middle, the batsman works it through square leg and takes a run. A boundary and then a single, smart batting.

FOUR! Welcome back into the attack says, Liton Das! Bangladesh are cruising at the moment. This is floated up on off, Das lunges and times it through covers. Beats the fielders inside the ring and then there is no stopping that.
Brandon Mavuta is back on. 3-0-29-0 so far.
Tossed up outside off, Liton lunges to flick but the ball spins away, induces a leading edge and rolls towards mid off.
Full and outside off, punched through the covers for a couple.

16TH ODI FIFTY FOR KAYES! Third against Zimbabwe. Follows his century from Dhaka. Short and outside off, Imrul rocks back and punches it through the covers for a run. The Bangladesh dressing room stands up and applauds.
Very full outside off, pushed back to the bowler. Still on 49...
Fuller, around off, flicked towards long on for a single.
Around middle and off, helped straight to short mid-wicket.
A bouncer on middle, Imrul ducks.
Pushes this down the ground and gets a single as mid on slides to his left. 129 more needed from 181 balls.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
On a length outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight back to the bowler.
Full on middle, pushed towards long on for one.
Down the leg side, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Around off, pushed towards long off for a single.
Dropped short, pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off, left alone.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Down the leg side, Kayes flicks it towards deep backward square leg for a boundary!
Tendai Chatara is back on.
Outside off, played straight to point.
FOUR! Dropped short, Das rocks back and pulls it wayyy over mid-wicket for a boundary!
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Dropped short, calmly pulled towards backward square leg for a single.

DRINKS BREAK. Does it need a rocket scientist to figure out who is on top? Let us not say much then. Zimbabwe have got nothing to offer on a deck which is not giving them an inch. No spin, no swing. To make matters worse, dew has made its presence felt, which is now being swept off the surface...
On middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman plays a sweep shot. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Fine shot! Full and outside off, Kayes dances down the track and lofts it nonchalantly over cover for a boundary!
Pushed up outside off, eased through the covers for a run.
On middle and leg, helped fine again, for a single.
The batsman has played it fine down the leg side.
WIDE. The batsman goes after a wide one but misses. Wide signalled by the umpire.
FOUR! A tad short, this time Liton drags it behind square leg for consecutive boundaries!
FOUR! Full and around off, Das sweeps it behind square leg for a boundary!
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. Two runs added to the total.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full on middle and leg, flicked away for a single.
Sean Williams introduced.
Sean Williams introduced.
On middle and leg, flicked away for a run. 15 from that over!
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
FOUR! CLUNK! Tossed up outside off, Das gets down and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary!

WIDE. Well outside leg, Kayes looks to flick but misses. Brendan Taylor behind is not able to stop it as he gets his right foot across but the ball goes off his pads behind. By the time Hamilton Masakadza can get across from short fine leg, a quick single is taken. The stand moves to 70 from 75 balls.
Short and outside off, slapped through the covers for a single. 179 more needed from 225 balls.

SIX! For a second, it seemed like he mistimed it. But when the ball came down, it crossed the boundary ropes. Full and outside off, Das reached out to slog sweep but because he was playing against the turn, he had to fetch it. Miscued it over mid on but had enough to get it beyond the boundary. First of the innings.
Landed around off, spinning away, Das watchfully plays it out.
Landed outside off, punched straight to cover.
Around off, worked towards fine leg for a run. Das joins the 30s club now.
A nice, testing bouncer, Liton ducks.
Outside off, watchfully steered towards third man for a single. Moves to 30 from 35 balls. The stand is now worth 60 from 69 balls.

FOUR! Easy pickings. Really too easy. Coming from around the wicket and bowling on the pads, with fine leg up. Christmas comes early for Kayes who flicks it past short fine leg for a boundary. He has now joined Das on 29. Not too long ago, Das was on 24 and he was on 4. Great acceleration. 188 more needed from 232 balls.
Full and around off, pushed towards cover.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
On middle and leg, swiped through square leg for one.
Fractionally short, Kayes looks to pull but the ball skids on and goes off the bottom edge towards short fine leg.
Landed outside off, steered behind point for a couple.
Works this through the leg side for a run.
On middle, a tad short, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
POWERPLAY 2 HAS BEEN SIGNALLED. 4 fielders now allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Brandon Mavuta has been called on to bowl...
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. 51/0 in Powerplay 1 for Bangladesh. Commendable one.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region again.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
On middle and leg, helped towards square leg for a run. 50 UP FOR BANGLADESH. This is a decent start. Just their third 50-plus stand in 2018, out of 16 innings.
Fractionally short outside off, Kayes stand stall and punches it towards cover.
On a length wide outside off, Das reaches out and steers it with an open face towards third man for a single.
On middle and leg, flicked through square leg for a brace. 199 more needed from 246 balls. Kayes moves to 20 from 26 balls.
Full and in line of the stumps, dabbed straight to point.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot for a single.

A short ball, on middle, pulled over mid-wicket for a run.
A length ball outside off, Imrul goes for the pull but gets a bottom edge towards mid on.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.

EDGED, FOUR! Streaky boundary for Kayes. Tiripano lands it on a length outside off and gets it to move away a touch. Kayes feels for it, probably aiming to run it down to third man but the ball goes off the outside edge past the keeper, through the vacant slip cordon, to third man!
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
First change of the evening. Donald Tiripano to bowl.
Around off, defended watchfully.
Full and around off, driben straight back.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
On a length outside off, steered behind point for a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
On a length outside off, punched straight to cover.
Full and outside off, sliced over point for a single towards deep backward point. Moves to 10 from 14 balls.
Full and just around middle, watchfully defended.

IN THE AIR... FOUR! A teaser for the man at point. Hard to call that a drop, but technically, it is one. Full and wide outside off, Kayes leans and slices it over point. Brandon Mavuta over there, flies to his left, but only manages finger-tips to it. The ball races to the point fence.
On middle and leg, helped through mid on for a run.
Short in length, outside off, punched straight to cover.
Outside off, played through point for a single.

FOUR! Excellent timing! Das is on a roll here. A length ball this time, around off, Liton just half-pulls, half-flicks and gets it through mid-wicket for a boundary! 218 more needed from 270 balls. 10 from the over. Spoils Jarvis' figures slightly, who had conceded just 3 in his first 2 overs.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
FOUR! Well played! Fractionally short in length, around off, Das swivels and pulls it over square leg for a boundary! Moves to 20 from 19 balls, with 4 boundaries!
Around off, nicely defended.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot for a single.
Full and outside off, Das eases into this one and drives it through the covers for a single.
A length ball around off, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
Full on middle and leg, flicked straight to mid-wicket.

FOUR! Lovely timing. Chatara goes too full and keeps it very straight as well. Das flicks it wide of mid on and the ball races away. Elton Chigumbura gives it a good chase from mid on, dives near the ropes but in vain.
Down the leg side, flicked away for a run.
Full on middle, pushed straight to mid on.
WIDE. Well outside leg, Kayes misses out on the pull.
Pitched around leg, Kayes looks to defend but gets squared up. The ball goes off the outside edge towards cover.
Outside off, pushed towards cover.
Down the leg side, flicked towards fine leg for a run.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.

Huge appeal for LBW, turned down. Jarvis bowls a length ball around leg, Kayes looks to tuck but misses and is hit on the pads. Jarvis appeals but it is turned down. He has a long chat with Brendan Taylor and then Hamilton Masakadza joins the conversation. Eventually, they decide against the review. Good decision. Hawk Eye shows that to be pitched at least 2 metres outside leg.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
EDGED, BUT SAFE! Full and just outside off, Kayes looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge which lands just short of second slip!
Landed outside off, watchfully left alone.
FOUR! On the pads this time, Das just helps it behind square leg and gets consecutive boundaries!
FOUR! The crowd roars! What a shot. On a length, just outside off. Das gets on top of the bounce and punches it through the covers for a boundary!
Outside off, fractionally short, Liton looks to cut but misses.
A short ball, outside off, Das pulls it straight to short mid-wicket.
Down the leg side, on a length, helped towards fine leg for a single.
Tendai Chatara to bowl with the second new ball.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
Fine shot. On a length outside off, LD punches it through the covers for a couple.

NOT OUT! Terrific review from Das! Hawk Eye shows the ball to be missing leg! Lovely ball from Jarvis, landing it on a length outside off and getting it to jag back in. Litton falls over in his attempt to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. Jarvis appeals and the umpire upholds it. Das walks across to Kayes and has a long chat. Eventually, they decide to refer it upstairs and replays bring a smile to Das' face.
Das has been adjudged LBW! He has a long chat with Kayes and then signals for the review. Looks close...
That is a jaffa! On a length around off, Litton looks to defend but at the last moment, the ball moves away and squares him up, narrowly missing the outside edge. Brendan Taylor fumbles behind.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Comes in from over the wicket and lands this on middle and leg. Das taps it to the on side.
We are back for the chase. Liton Das and Imrul Kayes will open for the hosts. For Zimbabwe, Kyle Jarvis is given the new ball.
We are back for the chase. Liton Das and Imrul Kayes will open for the hosts. For Zimbabwe, Tendai Chatara is given the new ball.
